original_test_intent: Stress CPU using the approved PTAT -ct 1 profile for a continuous hour and prove meaningful processor load completes without hang, new hardware errors or loss of system manageability.
original_method: Verify licensed PTAT hash/version/platform support and -ct 1 semantics; baseline CPU topology, firmware, clocks, logs and cooling; run exact command under a 60-minute hard supervisor; sample per-socket utilization/frequency/power/temperature/throttle/RAS and heartbeat; preserve full PTAT output and bounded logs; abort/recover via OOB on limit, hang or watchdog failure.
manual_activity: Engineer approves PTAT and CPU stress envelope; operator maintains cooling, power and OOB recovery.
safety_requirements: Use hard timeout and independent telemetry

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `./ptat -ct 1` under a 60-minute external supervisor with synchronized OS/BMC telemetry and logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: -ct 1 and one hour retained exactly pending vendor-semantic confirmation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Pair exact PTAT workload with independent per-socket telemetry, heartbeat, hard abort and post-stress health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds provenance, measurable load, numeric limits and OOB recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Showing PTAT help or a zero exit cannot prove one hour of CPU stress or absence of throttling/hardware errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An opaque vendor profile may stress different units across releases; sustained CPU power can expose cooling/feed limits or hang the host.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines expected per-socket utilization, frequency/power behavior, allowed throttling, sensor limits, heartbeat interval and error allowlist.

review_improvement: Makes CPU load duration and platform health independently observable instead of relying on PTAT availability or exit alone.
independent_technical_reasoning: A workload can run for an hour while being throttled below the intended stress or while accumulating corrected hardware errors. Per-socket time series and bounded logs are therefore necessary to distinguish endurance from ineffective or degrading execution.
